cases.name: plain
cases.when: removable() is false or absent -- the common case, a plain tone dot and projected content with no interactive affordance
cases.reason: Without `removable` arena-tag is a label: a tone dot and projected content, with nothing to press. No interactive pattern applies, and binding one with an exception would tell a reader the pattern always holds.

cases.name: removable
cases.when: removable() is true -- a real <button> renders inside the tag

exceptions.reason: The remove button has no disabled concept at all -- aria-disabled is never set, and there is no input to make removal unavailable while the tag stays visible. A real gap rather than a description problem, and it survives this batch on purpose.
